method: 9-word shingle hashing over normalized bodies (URLs and punctuation stripped), inverted-index candidate generation, Jaccard-min overlap. Identity is judged by TEXT, not by title — the failure mode this instrument exists to correct.
why: MANUS question 2026-08-04 ("how did you search, with what terms?") exposed that every duplicate/pairing search this session was title-gated (title substring + hand-picked probes). Title matching is structurally blind to this archive's most common duplicate form: metadata packets, capture-titled records, and superseded variants that carry DIFFERENT titles for the SAME text.
